# Environment variables

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    Generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py` — do not edit by hand. Run the script after changing the code.

Every backend setting, read from `backend/app/config.py` (class `Settings`). Set them in `.env` at the repository root or as environment variables. A blank value counts as unset. Defaults are the code defaults; `docker-compose.yml` and `render.yaml` override some of them.

## General

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_ENV` | `str` | `dev` | dev creates tables automatically and allows weak dev secrets; production requires a strong JWT secret and real CORS origins |
| `CAREFLOW_TIMEZONE` | `str` | `Asia/Kolkata` | the hospital's local time zone (IANA name); used for weekdays, hours and "today" |
| `CAREFLOW_DATABASE_URL (or DATABASE_URL)` | `str` | `postgresql+asyncpg://careflow:careflow@localhost:5432/careflow` | PostgreSQL connection string; CAREFLOW_DATABASE_URL wins over Neon's DATABASE_URL |
| `CAREFLOW_REDIS_URL` | `str` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis for the event stream, locks, rate limits and the dashboard cache; optional (events run inline without it) |

## Auth

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_JWT_SECRET` | `str` | `dev-only-insecure-secret-change-me-0123456789` | signs sign-in tokens; required outside dev: 32+ random characters (openssl rand -hex 32) |
| `CAREFLOW_JWT_ISSUER` | `str` | `careflow` | issuer claim written into and checked on local tokens |
| `CAREFLOW_JWT_TTL_MINUTES` | `int` | `60` | how long a sign-in lasts before the user must sign in again |
| `CAREFLOW_OIDC_JWKS_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | accept tokens from an OIDC provider (e.g. Keycloak) verified against this JWKS URL |
| `CAREFLOW_OIDC_AUDIENCE` | `str \| None` | `unset` | expected audience of OIDC tokens |

## LLM

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_LLM_MODE` | `str` | `auto` | auto \| off \| groq |
| `CAREFLOW_GROQ_API_KEY` | `str \| None` | `unset` | turns on the Groq LLM agents; without it the deterministic fallbacks run |
| `CAREFLOW_GROQ_MODEL_SMALL` | `str` | `openai/gpt-oss-20b` | Groq model for planning and reporting |
| `CAREFLOW_GROQ_MODEL_LARGE` | `str` | `openai/gpt-oss-120b` | Groq model for blocker analysis |
| `CAREFLOW_LLM_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND` | `float` | `0.5` | client-side rate limit for Groq calls (free tier: about 0.5) |
| `CAREFLOW_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `30.0` | per-call timeout before an agent falls back to its deterministic version |

## Integrations

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_FHIR_BASE_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | e.g. http://hapi:8080/fhir ; unset = local patient store |
| `CAREFLOW_FHIR_TOKEN` | `str \| None` | `unset` | bearer token sent to the FHIR server |

## Hospital system integrations

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_HL7_MLLP_PORT` | `int` | `2575` | the `hl7` service listens here (python -m app.integrations.mllp) |
| `CAREFLOW_HL7_TENANT` | `str \| None` | `unset` | tenant slug for MLLP messages; defaults to the only/first hospital |
| `CAREFLOW_HL7_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `list[str]` | `[]` | empty = accept from any host (restrict this in production) |
| `CAREFLOW_HL7_OUTBOUND_HOST` | `str \| None` | `unset` | HIS MLLP listener that receives ADT^A03 on discharge |
| `CAREFLOW_HL7_OUTBOUND_PORT` | `int` | `2575` | port of the HIS MLLP listener for outbound ADT^A03 |
| `CAREFLOW_HIS_WEBHOOK_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | outbound JSON notifications per system |
| `CAREFLOW_TPA_WEBHOOK_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | outbound JSON notifications to the TPA / payer system |
| `CAREFLOW_PHARMACY_WEBHOOK_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | outbound JSON notifications to the pharmacy system |
| `CAREFLOW_LIS_WEBHOOK_URL` | `str \| None` | `unset` | outbound JSON notifications to the laboratory system (LIS) |
| `CAREFLOW_OUTBOUND_SECRET` | `str \| None` | `unset` | HMAC-SHA256 key for the X-CareFlow-Signature header |
| `CAREFLOW_OUTBOUND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `10.0` | per-attempt timeout for outbound webhooks and HL7 |

## Security

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_LOGIN_MAX_FAILURES` | `int` | `5` | wrong passwords in a row before an account is locked |
| `CAREFLOW_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES` | `int` | `15` | how long a locked account stays locked |
| `CAREFLOW_API_DOCS` | `bool` | `True` | /docs and /openapi.json; production compose turns this off |

## Runtime

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_SEED_DEMO` | `bool` | `False` | tests only: load the 8 synthetic patients and demo users on an empty database |
| `CAREFLOW_EMBEDDED_WORKER` | `bool` | `True` | run the event consumer inside the API process (dev) |
| `CAREFLOW_CHECKPOINTER` | `str` | `postgres` | postgres \| memory |
| `CAREFLOW_MAX_ITERATIONS` | `int` | `4` | re-plan loops allowed per graph run |
| `CAREFLOW_CORS_ORIGINS` | `list[str]` | `["http://localhost:3000"]` | web origins allowed to call the API (JSON list); '*' is refused outside dev |
| `CAREFLOW_EXECUTIVE_CACHE_SECONDS` | `int` | `15` | Director dashboard cache in Redis; 0 turns it off |
| `CAREFLOW_DB_POOL_SIZE` | `int` | `5` | per process; keep (pool + overflow) x processes under the database's connection limit |
| `CAREFLOW_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `int` | `5` | extra connections a process may open above the pool size under load |
| `CAREFLOW_DB_STATS` | `bool` | `False` | add X-DB-Queries / X-DB-Time-Ms headers to every response (benchmarking, not production) |

## Ask CareFlow

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_ASK_TIMEOUT` | `float` | `30.0` | seconds per question; on timeout the verified part is returned, marked partial |
| `CAREFLOW_ASK_RATE_PER_HOUR` | `int` | `30` | questions per user per hour (Redis; in-memory if Redis is down) |
| `CAREFLOW_ASK_CACHE_SECONDS` | `int` | `300` | identical questions from the same hospital on the same day reuse the answer; 0 turns it off |

## Administrative SLAs

| Variable | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CAREFLOW_SLA_PHARMACY` | `int` | `60` | minutes after the order before unready medicines become a pharmacy delay |
| `CAREFLOW_SLA_DOCUMENTATION` | `int` | `45` | not used yet: no check reads it (documentation has no time limit today) |
| `CAREFLOW_SLA_INSURANCE` | `int` | `90` | minutes after submission before a silent payer becomes a payer delay |
| `CAREFLOW_SLA_BILLING` | `int` | `45` | minutes since the last billing update before a bill in preparation becomes a billing delay |
| `CAREFLOW_SLA_LABORATORY` | `int` | `60` | not used yet: no check reads it (an unacknowledged final report is flagged at once) |
